scaleout_overlap_conditional.caveat: Conditional overlap with activations that reached ready, not counterfactual causation. Cancelled paths retained separately.
Observed temporal overlap, not counterfactual startup causation.

diagnosis.phase_definition: W0 has rotation500; W2 rotation100. Reporting windows are labelled; no paired causal comparison across different adapters.
caveats: Different predefined workload profiles share source arrivals but not adapter assignment; no paired treatment or independent repeat claim.
Tier, replica and largest-stage groups are endogenous conditional diagnostics, not common controlled populations.
Stage spans include queue/IPC/scheduling and overlapping background work, not function CPU time or GPU kernel time.
Control histograms count samples, not time; held-GPU durations integrate actual physical union intervals.
No stage is subtracted from TTFT and no unknown numerical correctness is imputed.
